edges: The President has full confidence in the Secret Service.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Gonzalez is accused of unlawfully entering a restricted building while carrying a deadly or dangerous weapon.
Gonzalez appeared in court where a judge made a decision regarding his risk and danger status.
The Secret Service stated that Gonzalez should have been stopped faster.
